info.title: WhatPing API
info.description:
Provision monitors and read their state.

Writes are validated by the same code the dashboard uses, so the API accepts exactly what the interface accepts and nothing more.

bearerAuth.description: A workspace API key, `sk_…`. Scoped read or write.

get.description:
Destinations are redacted. The API cannot read back a stored credential.

Requires a `read` key.

401.description: Missing, unknown, revoked or expired key

403.description: The key lacks the required scope

404.description: Not found, or not in this workspace
